reviewer: Independent implementation reviewer; same AI model family, not a human user study
method: Six unauthenticated real Chrome screens inspected visually after capture; visible controls and their viewport positions recorded. Prior project/security-review familiarity exists; this is not a blinded first-ever user trial.

checks.method: Open managed / and /app/ without signing in and inspect visible controls
checks.expected: A new developer can understand completion checking and discover a safe next step even while calls are paused
checks.observed: Only sign-in and pause explanations are exposed. No visible path to completion checking or AI connection setup. Registration is stopped, so a new visitor has no usable next step.
checks.request: Add a clear product purpose and safe links to existing completion-check and connection guidance without changing service availability.

checks.method: Locate MCP URL and Claude command before signing in, compare their vertical positions
checks.expected: Setup actions are easy to discover from the connection entry screen
checks.observed: MCP URL begins at y1273 desktop / y1394 mobile; Claude copy action begins at y1800 mobile. Long pause and login content dominates the first viewport.
checks.request: Expose setup choice or in-page entry near the introduction and condense repeated service-state wording.

checks.method: Compare the same logged-out task between managed / and /app/
checks.expected: Consistent identity and explanation for the same product
checks.observed: Managed / uses a plain round mark and warm flat layout, while /app/ uses the green illustrated mark, cool background and white card. Pause information is repeated above and below the form.
checks.request: Unify the mark, shared controls and status hierarchy; retain truthful paused state.

checks.expected: The visitor can orient before choosing to sign in
checks.observed: The email field is focused immediately. The actual mobile on-screen keyboard was not exercised.
checks.suggestion: Consider autofocus only after an explicit sign-in choice; do not claim measured keyboard obstruction.

checks.method: Inspect all six 1440/390 captures and runtime exception count
checks.expected: No horizontal clipping or script crash
checks.observed: All six views fit horizontally; runtime exception count is zero. Every stored screenshot was opened for visual inspection.

checks.method: Inspect safe metadata after an existing operator session
checks.expected: Observe the real authenticated home without creating business data
checks.observed: Both widths render without overflow or runtime exceptions. No direct /connect or check.html anchor was found on the home. Private content was not captured; deeper navigation has not been evaluated.

checks.method: Attempt eligibility for real sales task verification
checks.expected: Use an existing appropriate real sales request through review and results
checks.observed: Suitable real sales data and external-action authorization are absent. No fabricated customer, product, conversation or result was created.

limitations: Award eligibility and jury assessment are not established by this review.
No public deployment, phone call, payment or email was executed.
Before capture stores timestamp and real screenshots; the full dirty-source fingerprint was not captured at that time. Later capture mode now records revision and tracked diff hash.
Authenticated observations intentionally omit identifying business text and screenshots.
